newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Irish July retail sales value falls 0.7 pct m/m.
newsitem.headline: Irish July retail sales value falls 0.7 pct m/m.

text.p: The value of Irish retail sales fell a provisional seasonally adjusted 0.7 percent in July, giving a year-on-year increase of 7.4 percent, Central Statistics Office (CSO) data showed on Friday.

In June, retail sales value was down 0.4 percent over the month and up 11.7 percent year-on-year. This was revised from last month's provisional figures which showed retail sales value unchanged in June and up 12.2 percent over the year.
Sales volume in June was down 0.6 percent on May and was 9.7 percent higher than in June last year.
